# lmw connect

Send a connection request (asks for confirmation)

```
lmw connect PROFILE [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw connect ada-lovelace
  lmw connect https://www.linkedin.com/in/ada-lovelace/ --note "Loved your talk on engines."
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help          help for connect
      --note string   a personal note (up to 300 characters)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json      print JSON output
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
